items.text: Giants QB Jaxson Dart believed to have suffered sprained MCL on MNF; ruled out for game, expected to miss some time (possibly 2-4 weeks). X-rays negative, MRI Tuesday. Jameis Winston in as backup.
items.why: Knee injury on opening drive; sprained MCL per sources.
items.implication: Winston starts short-term; Giants offense downgrade, impacts Nabers/Skattebo.

items.text: Puka Nacua (hip) officially inactive for MNF vs Giants. With Nacua out, Davante Adams led routes (27), followed by Terrance Ferguson (23) and Konata Mumpfield (21) on 33 Stafford dropbacks.
items.implication: Adams primary target; short-term WR2/3 upside for backups if Nacua misses more.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for Adams and secondary WRs/TEs.

items.text: Eagles TE Dallas Goedert suffered sprained MCL vs Titans; expected to miss a few weeks. Eagles signing Zach Ertz to PS. Johnny Mundt saw increased snaps in relief.
items.implication: TE streamer needed; targets may shift to Wicks/Smith. Ertz potential stash.
items.opportunity: Increased TE snaps/targets for Mundt; WR upside for Dontayvion Wicks.

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels (dislocated left elbow, reinjury) out for Week 3; seeing specialists, timeline unclear. Mariota to start. X-rays negative.
items.implication: Mariota streamer; WAS pass game downgrade short-term.

items.text: Giants RBs all active but Cam Skattebo led with 34 snaps/16 opportunities vs Singletary 15/4 and Najee Harris 8/4 (Tracy ST only). Clear lead role in Dart/Winston offense.
items.implication: Skattebo RB2/flex with volume; handcuff value rises with Dart out.
items.opportunity: High snap/carry share as lead back.

items.text: Colts WR Alec Pierce out next several weeks rehabbing aggravated heel injury (post-surgery); hoping midseason return, no further surgery.
items.implication: Colts WR depth thins; targets to Pittman (if healthy)/Downs/Pierce backups.

items.text: Bucky Irving separating from Kenny Gainwell: 51-23 snaps, 17-2 carries, 22-12 routes in Week 2. Season opps 36-12. Sean Tucker active but 0 offensive snaps.
items.implication: Irving every-week starter; Gainwell handcuff only.

items.text: ETR postgame watchlist: Caleb Williams (hamstring), Jayden Daniels (elbow), Saquon Barkley (stinger), Dallas Goedert (knee), others including Reed, Brooks, Dobbins, Njoku.
items.why: Multiple key players exited or limited Sunday.
items.implication: Monitor practice for Week 3; potential absences create handcuff/waiver value.
items.opportunity: Role expansion for backups if OUT.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (cracked rib) officially ACTIVE for Week 2; optimism confirmed, flak jacket possible. ETR projected in with docks.
items.why: Improved practice, team optimism per Rapoport.
items.implication: Startable WR with possible limited snaps/efficiency docks.
items.opportunity: Full or near-full route share if healthy.

items.text: RJ Harvey (hamstring) inactive Week 2. Grab Jonah Coleman as beneficiary/stash. ETR not expected to play.
items.implication: Coleman or committee gets work; Harvey stash for return.

items.text: Kyren Williams 7 inside-20 opportunities this season vs Blake Corum 0 (last year 60-27). Firm goal-line/red-zone role.
items.implication: Williams locked as RB1 with TD upside; Corum limited.

items.text: With Puka out, Berry pivots: Parkinson flex if open; else Malachi Fields then Konata Mumpford at WR.
items.implication: Deep-league stashes/streamers for LAR pass catchers.

items.text: Najee Harris officially active for Giants debut on MNF; limited to 8 snaps/4 opps behind Skattebo.
items.implication: Committee but Skattebo lead; Harris depth.

items.text: Quentin Johnston YPRR horrific at 0.48 in 2026 (prior years 0.88/1.63/1.44). Continued inefficiency.
items.implication: Avoid/sit; low efficiency despite targets possible.
